title: FixSuggestion
description: A candidate code fix proposed by the Fix Engine in response to a Diagnosis.

fix_id.description: Unique identifier for this fix candidate (UUID).

diagnosis_id.description: ID of the Diagnosis this fix addresses.

summary.description: Short human-readable description of what the fix does.

rationale.description: Explanation of why this change resolves the root cause.

diff.description: The proposed change as a unified diff (git patch format).

affected_files.description: List of file paths modified by this fix.

risk_level.description: Estimated risk/blast-radius of applying this fix.

rank.description: Rank among multiple candidate fixes for the same diagnosis (1 = best).

requires_new_test.description: Whether a new reproduction test should be generated to cover this fix.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of this fix.
